name: screencam_junk_2026_10_22
description: A ScreenCam error report from a tester landed in the owner's Outlook junk folder on 2026-10-22: capture.diskWriteFailed in 1.0.10 after the owner's fixes the day before. The owner maintains ScreenCam and the same tester's feedback mails are in the inbox. Staging did not read the junk folder and missed it. Read from junk, it concerns the owner's own product and reaches the Router. Phishing in the junk folder that claims a deadline or a loss does not.
user_md:
# User

- About you · duty: Kai maintains the ScreenCam Windows screen recorder and fixes its recording and saving failures.
- About you · ongoing: Kai shipped a batch of ScreenCam recording fixes on 2026-10-21 (commit 7a8981acc315) and follows tester feedback on them.
